Name: Zebadiah, Son of Asahel
Summary: Son of Asahel, captain after his father over the fourth month's course.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 27:7: Son of Asahel, captain after his father over the fourth month's course.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zebadiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
